integrity: Proof includes full Laplacian and edge-orbit calculations; the exact-rational standard-library checker supports but does not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Canonical Euclidean-orthogonal projections only, on the simple unweighted triangular and complementary Kneser two-subset families. No minimum norm among arbitrary projections is claimed. No exhaustive bibliography or independent validation.
title: Exact endpoint Hodge norms and separated finite peaks on complementary two-subset graphs
